verses: A Ma῾alot Poem. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Yisra᾽el now say:
many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
The ploughers ploughed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
The Lord is righteous: he has cut asunder the cord of the wicked.
Let them be confounded and turned back, all who hate Żiyyon.
Let them be like the grass upon the housetops, which withers before it is plucked:
wherewith the mower fills not his hand; nor he who binds sheaves his bosom.
Nor do they who go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.
